_about: Michael Shields, clerk to the United Societies of the persecuted Covenanters, brother of Alexander Shields: Faithful Contendings Displayed, an historical relation of the state and actings of the suffering remnant in the Church of Scotland, 1681-1691, with James Guthrie's Ten Considerations and sermons by John Kid, John King and others, ed. John Howie (Glasgow, 1780). Set in long-s type; the OCR breaks the name on the title page but carries it in the text. Named michael-shields so his brother's shelf cannot collide.
